title: Gas Station

contractDetails.constraints: Both arrays have the same length in [1,100000]. Entries are integers in [0,10000]. If a start works, it is unique.

statement: Stations form a clockwise loop. At each station you collect its gas and then spend the listed cost to reach the next station. Start with an empty tank. Return the zero-based start for a full lap, or −1 if no start works.

examples.explanation: Station 1 provides enough fuel to cover both deficits.
The lap costs more than the stations supply.
The only station permits a zero-cost lap.

constraints: Both arrays have the same length in [1,100000]. Entries are integers in [0,10000]. If a start works, it is unique.
hints: Conceptual: A lap must have enough total fuel.
Directional: If a segment runs a deficit, no station inside that failed segment can start a successful lap.
Implementation: Track both total surplus and surplus since the candidate start. Move the candidate past any deficit.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
